原句.原句: The control electrolyte (DME electrolyte) was prepared by dissolving 0.75 m LiFSI and 0.4 m LiNO3 in DME.
LiFSI:LiNO3:DME:cosolvent = 1.9:1.0:18.5:3.8, resulting in a ﬂuorinated solvent volume fraction of ≈20% in the DME-FE electrolyte

梯度.名称: 氟化醚共溶剂种类（按 Li⁺ 溶剂化由强到弱）
梯度.说明: 排序依据 ⁷Li NMR 高场位移；Li₂S₄ 最大溶解度也是同一顺序。梯度变量是共溶剂种类，不是连续用量

原句.原句: the upﬁeld shifts corresponding to Li+ increased in the following order: DME < DME-ETFE < DME-BTFE < DME-TFTFE < DME-TFOFE (Figure S6, Supporting Information), indicating that the Li+ solvating powers decreased in the same order

性质.依据: ⁷Li NMR；Raman 中接触离子对比例随溶剂化变弱而升高
性质.原句: indicating that the Li+ solvating powers decreased in the same order

性质.对象: Li₂S₄（加 0.5 m 后取上清液）
性质.原句: the maximum Li2S4 solubility was found to follow the order: DME > DME-ETFE > DME-BTFE > DME-TFTFE > DME-TFOFE

性质.排序含义: 由高到低（不含多硫化物）；含 Li₂S₄ 时 DME、ETFE、BTFE、TFTFE 相当
性质.依据: 电导率仪（Fig. S9、S18；数值只在图中）
性质.原句: The ionic conductivities decreased in the following order: DME > DME-ETFE≈DME-BTFE > DME-TFTFE > DME-TFOFE

性质.排序含义: 随溶剂化变弱而降低（原文：与溶剂化能力正相关）
性质.原句: the Li+ diﬀusion coeﬃcients were positively correlated with solvating power

性质.依据: 作者推测含 Li₂S₄ 的 DME 电导率下降“可能是黏度升高”，没有测

测试.作者N/P: 未报告（作者给 40 µm 锂约 8 mAh/cm²）
测试.化成: 0.05 C×2 + 0.1 C（正文称共 4 圈化成）

条件原句.原句: a high S-loaded electrode (3.8 mgs cm−2) obtained from LG Energy Solution Ltd. was used
Φ16-mm Li metal (40 μm, China Lithium) was used as the counter electrode
29.4 μL of electrolyte was injected to adjust the E/S ratio to 5
The cells were precycled for two cycles at 0.05 C, and subsequent cycles used 0.1 C. After precycling, these cells were cycled at 0.15 C.

结果.取值点: 容量保持 70% 时的圈数
结果.原句: The cycle numbers of the DME-TFTFE, DMEBTFE, DME, DME-ETFE, and DME-TFOFE electrolytes at a capacity retention of 70% were 154, 131, 36, 32, and 31 cycles, respectively

结果.取值点: 化成 4 圈后第 1 圈（0.15 C）
结果.原句: displayed slightly higher overpo-tentials than and similar discharge capacities as the DME elec-trolyte ‖ The DME-TFOFE electrolyte exhibited a 20% smaller dis-charge capacity

结果.取值点: 化成 4 圈后第 1 圈放电（0.15 C）
结果.原句: displayed slightly higher overpo-tentials ‖ a larger discharge overvoltage by 0.8 V than the DME electrolyte

测试.名称: 穿梭电流（95% 充电态开路）
测试.电池: Li‖S 扣式（按 Fig. 3 同组电池推定）
测试.条件说明: 🔶 原文没单独写这组电池的条件，按 Fig. 3 同一批推定

结果.排序: DME > TFOFE > ETFE、BTFE、TFTFE（数值只在图中）
结果.原句: was found to decrease in the following order: DME > weakly solvating electrolyte (DME-TFOFE) > moderately solvating electrolytes (DME-ETFE, DME-BTFE

测试.名称: Li‖Ni 锂沉积库仑效率（Aurbach 法）
测试.倍率: 1 mA/cm²；先沉积 1 mAh/cm²，再 0.2 mAh/cm² 循环 10 次

条件原句.原句: For the Li–Ni half-cell test using the Aurbach method, Φ12-mm Li foil (40 μm, China Lithium), Φ16-mm Ni foil (Welcos), and a Celgard 2400 separator were used. The amount of injected electrolyte was 30 μL.

结果.原句: The Coulombic eﬃciencies of the DME-TFOFE, DME-TFTFE, DME-BTFE, DME-ETFE, and DME electrolytes were measured to be 97.18, 96.81, 96.19, 95.31, and 95.42%, respectively

测试.名称: Li‖Ni 长循环（100 圈平均 CE）

条件原句.原句: Li/Ni asymmetric cell operated at 0.2 mA cm−2 with a capacity of 0.2 mAh cm−2 using 15 μL of each electrolyte

结果.排序: TFOFE > TFTFE > BTFE > ETFE > DME（数值只在图中）
结果.原句: The average Coulombic eﬃciency over 100 cycles was conﬁrmed to follow the order DME-TFOFE > DME-TFTFE > DME-BTFE > DME-ETFE > DME

测试.电池: Li‖S 软包（1 片双面正极 + 2 片锂）

条件原句.原句: The double-side-coated sulfur cathode on Al foil with 2.5 mgs cm−2 provided by LG Energy Solution Ltd. was used for pouch-cell assembly
μm-thick Li foil was cut into 4 × 6 cm2 pieces
336 μL of electrolyte was injected to adjust the E/S ratio to 3.5
with an E/S ratio of 3.5 were precycled at 0.025 C for two cycles and 0.05 C for two additional cycles and subsequently cycled at 0.1 C

结果.取值点: 容量保持 70% 时的圈数
结果.原句: TFTFE electrolyte showed 70% capacity retention at the 135th cycle, 25% longer than that of the DME electrolyte

测试.硫载量说明: 🔶 每面；方法段写该正极“用于软包组装”，推定叠片也用

条件原句.原句: The volume of electrolyte corresponding to an E/S ratio of 2 was 0.825 mL
The pouch cells with an E/S ratio of 2 were cycled at 0.0125 C for two cycles, 0.025 C for one cycle, and subsequently cycled at 0.05 C

结果.备注: 🧮 DME 值按原文“超过 6 倍”反算：80 ÷ 6
结果.原句: exhibited stable cycling for 80 cycles, which is over sixfold longer than that of the DME electrolyte

机理测量.名称: 剩余活性锂（T1 电池循环 36 圈后，Li‖SUS 剥离）
机理测量.原句: the reversibilities followed the order DME-ETFE (3.5 mAh cm−2) < DME (5.1 mAh cm−2) ‖ BTFE (5.4 mAh cm−2) < DME-TFTFE (7.2 mAh cm−2)

机理测量.名称: DME 保留率（T1 电池循环 36 圈后，QNMR）
机理测量.原句: the percent retentions of DME in the DME, DME-ETFE, DME-BTFE, and DME-TFTFE electrolytes after 36 cycles are 56, 52, 68, and 70%
The percent retentions of FSI−in the DME, DME-ETFE, DME-BTFE, and ‖ TFTFE electrolytes were 68, 34, 45, and 73%

作者归因.概括: 锂负极可逆性提高、电解液（DME、FSI⁻）消耗减少；TFTFE 使锂沉积致密、腐蚀少
作者归因.依据: 在 T1 电池里循环 36 圈后直接测了剩余活性锂和 DME/FSI⁻ 余量（见机理测量）；只在扣式 T1 测，软包 T5、T6 没测
作者归因.原句: LMA reversibility is a decisive factor for achieving high cycling stability in a lean-electrolyte Li–S battery

作者归因.概括: 溶剂化太弱时，寿命改由硫正极的可逆性决定
作者归因.依据: TFOFE 首圈容量低 20%、过电位大、多硫化物溶解度最低；TFOFE 没测剩余活性锂和正极侧库存
作者归因.原句: indicating that the reversibility of the sulfur cathode determines the cycling stability when the solvating power of electrolyte is weak

作者归因.对象: ETFE、BTFE、TFTFE 过电位略大但容量相当
作者归因.概括: 含 Li₂S₄ 时各电解液电导率相近
作者归因.依据: 在含 0.5 m Li₂S₄ 的简化溶液里测电导率（Fig. S18）
作者归因.原句: This can be explained by the similar ionic conductivities of the electrolytes when Li2S4 is present

作者归因.概括: 调控溶剂结构可延长贫液软包寿命
作者归因.依据: 软包没有做任何诊断测量，是把扣式结论外推过去
作者归因.原句: This highlights the eﬀectiveness of controlling the solvent structure to improve the lifespan performances of Li–S pouch cells under lean-electrolyte conditions
